run_chat_completion: run the chat_completion endpoint to generate AI chat completions with streaming support and model access control
test_get_models: test the get_models endpoint that returns filtered available AI models accessible to the authenticated user
test_embeddings: test the embeddings endpoint that generates OpenAI-compatible embeddings for text inputs
run_get_app_config: run the get_app_config endpoint to retrieve application configuration, feature flags, and OAuth provider settings
test_healthcheck: test the healthcheck endpoint that verifies the Open WebUI server is running and responsive
